executable.Test Scenario: Navigate to My Info module from the left sidebar
executable.Preconditions: User has a valid authenticated session.
executable.Steps:
1. Log in with a valid authenticated session.
2. Click 'My Info' in the left sidebar.
executable.Expected Result: User is navigated to the My Info module, landing on the Personal Details tab with the employee card (name, photo) and tab strip visible; My Info is highlighted as the active sidebar item.
executable.Source: UI Exploration - Section 4 Module Overview, Section 5 Navigation Findings

executable.Test Scenario: Verify all 10 My Info tabs are visible and clickable
executable.Preconditions: User is on the My Info module.
executable.Steps:
1. Observe the tab strip under the employee name/photo.
2. Click each tab in turn: Personal Details, Contact Details, Emergency Contacts, Dependents, Immigration, Job, Salary, Report-to, Qualifications, Memberships.
executable.Expected Result: All 10 tabs are present in that order, each is clickable, and clicking a tab navigates to its own route (e.g. /pim/contactDetails/empNumber/7) while the active tab is visually highlighted.
executable.Source: UI Exploration - Section 5 Navigation Findings (Tabs, Module Navigation)

executable.Test Scenario: Verify the employee identity card persists when switching between tabs
executable.Preconditions: User is on the My Info module.

1. Note the employee name and photo shown in the left card on Personal Details.
2. Click through several other tabs (e.g. Contact Details, Qualifications).
executable.Expected Result: The left employee-identity card (name heading, photo, tab list) remains visible and unchanged; only the right-hand content panel changes per tab.
